ui_strikethrough.rationale: Specify a line through written characters, not an arbitrary line inside speech/text content. This is a narrow label for the strike checkbox.

ui_replace_palette23.proposed: kulupu kule li jo e ken ale ona. o wile e kule pi kama weka
ui_replace_palette23.accepted: kulupu kule li jo ala e ma tawa kule sin. o pana e kule sin lon ma pi kule wan.
ui_replace_palette23.rationale: Original says palette possesses all its abilities, not full, and requests a desired disappearing colour without explicit replacement. Revised: no space for new colour; put new colour in the place of one existing colour. Actual consumer replaces the selected slot.

formats22_select_page.rationale: Ask which page is wanted rather than command the user to want a page. Natural chooser heading without imposing a specific input method.

formats22_previous_page.reason: Page of past time risks implying a previously viewed or historical page, not immediate preceding page number. No sufficiently natural and precise sequence label established in this pass; retain fallback.

formats22_next_page.reason: Page of future time risks implying a future version rather than immediate next page number. Do not force an arithmetic instruction or vague temporal label; retain fallback pending better wording.

context_basis: Read all20 proposed values and corresponding English/context records. Independently checked current XML absence and direct Kotlin references.
Inspected actual paletteStore.add/replace failure branch: title must explain full palette and replacement of selected slot.
Inspected normalization reset action and assembly sort enum; restored sizes and modified-time sort terminology retain actual scope.

Existing lexicon is supporting context, not independent proof of correctness.
